title: rwb-deviation case and queue list slice: no read in the Ownership Map, no seam with the composed page, no path, field names or page bound, the flag derived twice and the pause projection without the rule package
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2, R7.3 and R9; context pack S8 rwb-deviation (service row, ownership rows, slides 3, 4, 8 and 13); split plan story line RWB-S8-E2033-APP; legacy RWB-E2-033 sections 2, 4, 5, 8, 11, 12, 14 and 15; FSD S8 Deviation handling v3 A1.2, A2.2, A2.3, A2.6 and A2.9; TSD S8 Deviation handling v2 T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A.1; RWB-P2-E2033-CON sections 7 and 12.2; RWB-P2-E2033-APP section 7; Architecture v5 slides 13, 41 and 45
description: (1) Ownership: the Ownership Map gives rwb-deviation two write operations, POST /cases/{caseId}/deviations and PATCH /deviations/{deviationId}, and no read, while the case and queue list of this legacy key needs the deviation state of a page of cases; the read is therefore declared on the service base with a gap. (2) Seam: the composed page of RWB-P2-E2033-CON and RWB-P2-E2033-APP consumes no S8 operation and takes deviationOpen from the rwb-case ageing read, so this answer is the evidence beside the flag and not a consumed row of that contract; the composed page carries the cell only at that contract's next revision, and the two answers are asserted equal in the meantime. (3) Names: no source prints the path, the query shape, the JSON field names, the page bound of a batched read or the view name of this slice. (4) Double derivation: recovery_case.deviation_open (DF-CAS-019) is rwb-case's copy of the flag and this service holds the open rows, so the fact exists twice and one test proves they agree. (5) Pause: pauseRequired is the projection of R-DEV-01, R-DEV-09 and R-DEV-18 and of FEAT-DVH-09, while DP-04 is not in this story's pattern set, so the read reports the rows and does not evaluate the DEV package; a change of the resume rule is a change of the raise and clear stories. (6) Test levels: the twelve legacy cases publish no level. (7) Criteria: legacy AC1 to AC11 are owned word for word by RWB-P2-E2033-APP, so this slice owns none. (8) Title scope: the status, owner and ageing columns are rwb-case's and rwb-integration's; this slice supplies the pause input and the deviation evidence only. (9) Message text: the FSD names MSG-GEN-006 without printing its text. (10) Dependency classes: the authorise, parameters and reference-data contracts consumed by this read are class C in fact while the plan's C row holds RWB-P2-E2033-CON only and its H row is None.
evidence: Ownership Map API rows for S8 name POST /cases/{caseId}/deviations and PATCH /deviations/{deviationId} only, with no GET; Ownership Map table row deviation owned by S8 in rwb_deviation and recovery_case owner P3 with field deviation_open (DF-CAS-019); Architecture v5 slide 13 row 'S8 Deviation' starts REST and event listens against P1 and Temporal and event against P10 and draws no read for the case list; slide 45 'REST is one hop: gateway to service, or a cached reference read'; legacy RWB-E2-033 section 2 'the prescription clock beside the stage clock so a paused case is not read as safe', section 4 step 6 'PrescriptionClockReader (this story): adds prescriptionClockStatus from the PRESCRIPTION timer', section 11 reads recovery_case, queue and timer, and section 12 'No event is published'; legacy BR4 'A deviation pauses the stage clock and keeps the prescription clock running'; RWB-P2-E2033-CON 12.2 lists eight consumed operations with none of S8 and takes deviationOpen from the ageing element of RWB-P3-E2011-CON; RWB-P2-E2033-APP section 7 Background 'Given the rwb-case contract mock returns case "RW-2026-000104" with deviation open Yes'; TSD S8 T3.1 deviation fields DF-CAS-036 to DF-CAS-045, T4 rules R-DEV-01 to R-DEV-22 over 9 states, T5.3 events DeviationRaised and DeviationCleared published, T6.1 rights RW-TEAMMGR R and RW-CASEOWN CRU, T-A.1 two write endpoints only; FSD S8 A2.9 'Holds more than one open deviation on a case, each with its own owner, and resumes only when all are cleared'.
area: Deviation (S8) case and queue list slice: ownership, seam with the composed page, contract names and pause projection
proposed: Keep GET /cases and GET /cases/export with rwb-case and the composed page with rwb-integration, and add the batched deviation read of this story on GET /api/recovery/deviation/v1/deviation-flags beside them, read only, one hop, with the page bound as a parameter row of rwb-case; keep deviationOpen on the page as the rwb-case field and assert it equal to this answer on every page, and add the read to the consumed set of RWB-P2-E2033-CON at its next revision so the deviation cell shows the code, the raised date, the contact stop and the paused state; fix the path, the field names, the page bound and the view name at that contract review; leave the DEV package out of this slice and treat pauseRequired as the projection of the open rows, with the resume rule owned by the raise and clear stories; record in the Change Register that the flag is derived twice and that the read is not an Ownership Map row.
